summary: Core landing-page + guided form + summary view are implemented, along with backend persistence for a single latest idea and a warm amber/orange theme. However, the frontend empty-state behavior for “no idea saved yet” is likely not implemented as specified because the fetch hook converts the backend trap into `null` without surfacing an error, while the UI’s empty-state message is only shown when `error` is present.

missing_requirements.requirement: If no idea has been saved yet, the UI shows an empty state message in English.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend `getLatestAppIdea` traps when no idea exists, but the frontend fetch hook catches that error and returns `null`, so React Query likely will not set `error`. The landing page shows the empty-state message only when `error && !isLoading`, so the empty state may never appear.
evidence: frontend/src/hooks/useLatestAppIdea.ts (catch returns null, does not rethrow)

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity + authenticated/anonymous actor plumbing via `useInternetIdentity` and `useActor`.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest did not request adding authentication/identity-driven actor management for this idea-capture flow (only noted as a non-goal to add other providers).

hallucinated_features.description: Custom encoding/serialization layer to pack extra idea fields into the backend `description` JSON string.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only required persisting the idea and fetching the latest; it did not require a JSON encoding scheme to fit a reduced backend type.
